name: agentpeers
description: Let your agents talk across platforms: Grokbot ↔ Dot, Claude Code ↔ Codex, and factual questions from ChatGPT to Dot.

interface.shortDescription: Connect your agents and ask Dot from ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Let Grokbot and Dot compare notes, let Claude Code and Codex coordinate work, and ask Dot approved factual questions from ordinary ChatGPT chats. This plugin installs the local Claude Code ↔ Codex connection on one Mac. Personal-agent conversations and ChatGPT factual access use a separate service you deploy in your Cloudflare account or on your server; follow the project setup guides. Installing this plugin does not deploy that service.
